variants.specifics: Brackenford: A townsman sends the player to Mayor Halvard, who gives a sword and a pass for the north gate and sends him to drive Red Corwin off Crow Hill.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Mayor Halvard shut the north gate on account of Red Corwin's bandits. He's looking for help. You'll find him in the town hall, in the center of town.

opening.speaker: Halvard
opening.text:
Grave news, stranger, grave news! Red Corwin and his bandits have seized the old watchtower on Crow Hill, north of town. From there they fall upon every cart and every traveler on the north road, and they grow bolder by the day!

I was forced to shut the north gate. Now the millers cannot sell their flour, the ferrymen sit idle on the Bracken, and the wolves of the Ashwood creep closer every night! Never in all my years have I seen such strange and desperate times. I have too few guards, and they are farmers' sons, not fighters. Brackenford is doomed unless someone acts!

Take this sword, and show this pass to Garrick at the north gate. Go to Crow Hill and drive Red Corwin and his cutthroats out of that tower! All Brackenford is counting on you!

journal.text: Drive Red Corwin and his bandits out of the watchtower on Crow Hill.

variants.specifics: Thrumm: Fobb sends the player to Warlord Gorran in the Great Hall; Gorran, sent word by Ulgrim, orders the player down to destroy Vorga the Stone Witch and gives gold and potions.

herald.speaker: Fobb
herald.text: Warlord Gorran has been shouting for you all morning! He's in the Great Hall. I'd hurry if I was you.

opening.speaker: Warlord Gorran
opening.text:
So! Ulgrim finally sent me somebody. About time! Stand up straight, lad, and listen well.

Vorga the Stone Witch has woken the Golems of the Deep Halls. Every night they march up the shafts and crush anything in their path! The mines of Thrumm have gone silent. This cannot stand!

You must go down into the Deep Halls and destroy Vorga. Take this gold and these potions. Dask can sell you a decent sword. Now go, and do not come back until the Witch is dead!

reminder.speaker: Warlord Gorran
reminder.text: What are you waiting for, lad? Vorga grows stronger every night!

journal.text: Go down into the Deep Halls and destroy Vorga the Stone Witch.

variants.specifics: Tharn: Wilk points the player to Mayor Dremmel in the Long House; the Mayor gives the key to the north gate and sends him after the Witch Vuldra in the Blackwater.

herald.speaker: Wilk
herald.text: Did you hear? The Zombies came up out of the bog again last night! Mayor Dremmel is in the Long House. Go see him!

opening.speaker: Mayor Dremmel
opening.text:
Grave news, lad, grave news. The Witch Vuldra's Zombies climbed up onto the walkways again last night, and this time they carried off the whole night watch!

Gundar says you can handle yourself. Good, because there is nobody left here who can. Take this key. It opens the north gate. Go out into the Blackwater, find Vuldra's hut and put an end to her!

And get some supplies first. Morla's inn and Harrok's shop are just down the walkway. Good luck!

reminder.speaker: Mayor Dremmel
reminder.text: Those Zombies get bolder every night.

journal.text: Find the Witch Vuldra's hut in the Blackwater and destroy her.

variants.specifics: Durnath: Pibb points the player to Lord Tavrin in the keep; Tavrin sends him north against the renegade Wizard Ostrigan at the Black Spire.

herald.speaker: Pibb
herald.text: You're the one Ruvane sent? Lord Tavrin is waiting for you in the great hall of the keep.

opening.speaker: Tavrin
opening.text:
Grim news, lad. Very grim. My scouts came back from the Black Spire last night. Not all of them. Ostrigan has woken the stone golems under the Spire, and his Imps fly over our walls whenever they please.

Ruvane tells me you are the one for this. Go north to the Black Spire. Find Ostrigan and put an end to him. Get what you need in town before you go, and don't waste any time.

reminder.speaker: Tavrin
reminder.text: Those Imps get bolder every night.

journal.text: Go to the Black Spire and stop the Wizard Ostrigan.

variants.specifics: Tullin: A townsman points the player to Mayor Dask, who orders him to Gull Isle against the Necromancer Ostrega and gives him the causeway key.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: The dead come up out of the lake every night now! Mayor Dask is expecting you. His house is up the hill.

opening.speaker: Mayor Dask
opening.text:
So Ambrel sent you. Good.

The Necromancer Ostrega holds the lighthouse on Gull Isle. His dead walk out of the lake and into our streets. Go out there and kill him.

Here is the key to the causeway gate. Show it to Bosk. Now go.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Dask
reminder.text: The causeway, lad! What are you waiting for?

journal.text: Cross the causeway to Gull Isle and destroy the Necromancer Ostrega.

variants.specifics: Quorran: Dobb points the player to Archmage Corvald, who gives him a staff and sends him north after Malgrith in the Bone Hills; Gammel the patron brought him here.

herald.speaker: Dobb
herald.text: You must be the one Gammel sent! Archmage Corvald has been asking for you all morning. His tower is in the middle of town.

opening.speaker: Corvald
opening.text:
So Gammel got you here in one piece. Good! I need every sword and spell I can find, lad.

Malgrith has raised the Undead in the Bone Hills, in a numerosity such as Quorran has never seen. Each night they creep closer to our walls!

Take this staff. Go north into the Bone Hills, find Malgrith and put an end to him. The Academy is counting on you!

reminder.speaker: Corvald
reminder.text: Go, lad! The Undead are getting closer every night!

journal.text: Find Malgrith in the Bone Hills and put an end to him.

variants.specifics: Tor Vessa: Dobb points the newcomer to Lord Kessick, who tells of the Kesh Tower's fall to Grisla's Undead and sends the player up the pass with gold and potions.

herald.speaker: Dobb
herald.text: You came up the pass alone?! Lord Kessick's been waiting on you. Great Hall, top of the stairs.

opening.speaker: Lord Kessick
opening.text:
So Marshal Tobrin sent you. Then you come at a black hour, lad. Last night the Kesh Tower fell. Grisla the Frost Witch came down out of the storm with an army of the Undead behind her, and my men in the tower fought until the last torch went out and then they rose up again and turned their swords on their own brothers and now they serve her!

The pass is closed. All the north is in peril while that wicked witch holds the Kesh Tower!

Take this gold and these potions, and get restocked in town. Then go up to the Kesh Tower and destroy Grisla the Frost Witch. Go now, and may all that is great protect you!

reminder.speaker: Lord Kessick
reminder.text: Why do you linger, lad? The Frost Witch grows stronger every night!

journal.text: Go up to the Kesh Tower and destroy Grisla the Frost Witch.

variants.specifics: Kildrun: Hilde points the player to Guildmaster Dravick in the Guild Hall, an old friend of Brunhold, who hands him a hammer and sends him down through the Lower Forges against the Ember Demons in the Great Forge.

herald.speaker: Hilde
herald.text: The furnaces have gone cold. No fire, no work. If you're looking for Guildmaster Dravick, he's in the Guild Hall.

opening.speaker: Guildmaster Dravick
opening.text:
So Brunhold sent you. Good, good. I'm afraid you've come at a terrible hour, lad.

The Ember Demons have climbed out of the Burning Pit and taken the Great Forge! Every furnace in Kildrun has gone cold, and our smiths are falling one by one.

Take this hammer. Go down through the Lower Forges and drive those Demons back into the Pit where they belong!

reminder.speaker: Guildmaster Dravick
reminder.text: Every hour those Demons hold the Great Forge, Kildrun grows colder. Go, lad!

journal.text: Drive the Ember Demons out of the Great Forge.

variants.specifics: Harrow Cross: Gimble points the player to Mayor Osgood at the Cartwheel Inn, who gives the cemetery gate key and sends him after the Necromancer Sabbek.

herald.speaker: Gimble
herald.text: Dead men on the road again last night. If you're the one Kestrin sent, Mayor Osgood's over at the Cartwheel Inn.

opening.speaker: Mayor Osgood
opening.text:
Grim news, lad. The Undead came right up to the crossroads last night. The Necromancer Sabbek is raising them from the graves on Gallows Hill, east of here, and every night there are more of them.

Kestrin said you would come, and not a day too soon!

Take this key. It opens the cemetery gate. Find Sabbek and destroy him, before Harrow Cross is overrun!

reminder.speaker: Mayor Osgood
reminder.text: Every hour you stand here, Sabbek digs up another grave! Go, lad!

journal.text: Find the Necromancer Sabbek on Gallows Hill and destroy him.

variants.specifics: Vardo: Marl points the player to Mayor Brumhold, who sends him after Bolgrum the Ogre Chief on Skarn Hill and gives the key to the north gate.

herald.speaker: Marl
herald.text: Are you the one Thalden sent? Mayor Brumhold has been waiting for you. His house is the big one by the well.

opening.speaker: Mayor Brumhold
opening.text:
Terrible news, lad. Last night the Ogres burned another farm and carried off every pig they could find. Vardo cannot take much more of this!

Thalden wrote that you were coming, and not a moment too soon. Bolgrum the Ogre Chief and his brutes are camped on Skarn Hill, north of the village. Go there and put an end to him, once and for all.

Take this key. It opens the north gate. Good luck!

reminder.speaker: Mayor Brumhold
reminder.text: Those Ogres get bolder every day.

journal.text: Defeat Bolgrum the Ogre Chief at his camp on Skarn Hill.
